# vantagekit (vendored)

`vantagekit.js` and `vantagekit-three.js` from `lhzn-io/vantagekit` tag `v0.8.2` (commit `ae6d905`), unmodified,
MIT license (`LICENSE`). vantagekit is not published to npm; it is the camera rig the topobathykit DEM viewer and
the biologger Omniverse viewer (`lhzn.vantagekit`) also use. Types for the parts the portal calls are in
`vantagekit-three.d.ts`.

To update: copy the two files from a newer tag and record the tag and commit here.
